units.source_text: 七月十一日在箱根告别赛续弈之后，

en.t: After the farewell match resumed in Hakone on July 11,

units.source_text: 负责名人安全、下榻奈良屋的《东京日日新闻》围棋记者砂田，

en.t: Sunada, the Tokyo Nichi Nichi Shimbun Go reporter who was responsible for the Master's safety and was staying at Naraya,

units.source_text: 于下次续弈的十六日前夕同我们聚会时说：

en.t: said when he met with us on the evening before the next resumption, on the 16th:
